Send an E-Mail via SMTP

Source: R/email.R
send_email.Rd

Sends a plain text e-mail (UTF-8) with curl::send_mail(). The SMTP settings are read from environment variables by default:

Usage

send_email(
  subject,
  body,
  to = Sys.getenv("EMAIL_TO"),
  from = Sys.getenv("EMAIL_FROM"),
  server = Sys.getenv("SMTP_SERVER"),
  port = Sys.getenv("SMTP_PORT", "465"),
  user = Sys.getenv("SMTP_USER"),
  password = Sys.getenv("SMTP_PASSWORD")
)

Arguments

subject

subject of the e-mail

body

text of the e-mail

to

recipient(s), character vector or comma separated string

from

sender, optionally with a display name ("Name

"). If empty, user is used.
server, port, user, password

SMTP settings

Value

TRUE (invisibly) if the e-mail was sent

Details

  • SMTP_SERVER: host name of the SMTP server, e.g. "smtp.ionos.de" (or a URL like "smtps://smtp.ionos.de:465")

  • SMTP_PORT: port (default: 465, SSL/TLS). With 587 or 25 the connection is upgraded with STARTTLS, which is required.

  • SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASSWORD: login (e.g. the full e-mail address and the password of the mailbox)

  • EMAIL_FROM: sender (default: SMTP_USER), e.g. "API Potsdam me@example.com"

  • EMAIL_TO: recipient(s), several separated by commas

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
Sys.setenv(
  SMTP_SERVER = "smtp.ionos.de",
  SMTP_USER = "me@example.com",
  SMTP_PASSWORD = "<password>",
  EMAIL_TO = "me@example.com"
)
send_email("Test", "Hallo!")
} # }
